items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Beryl said I just booked you on the 40 one- nighters

ctx.x: yeah, so we got together and the date, while I was waiting to see Moe Gail and them and he gave me a deposit -- he give me a deposit of about $250 see, so after he gave me the deposit, and then Moe Gail, asked me, what was so and so talking to you about. I said, well, I'm doing a date for him down in Washington and so on and so and so, and we got together on the date and so on, and Moe Gail said you don't need no money from him, take that check and give it back to him. You get it from us.

I said, that's all well and done, so they said okay, listen come on down and we'll talk again tomorrow, and I said okay, and in the meantime, Johnny Tomino gets back in town and he talks very loud -- do you remember Beryl Adams -- GMAC, I believe it was? And Beryl was booking with GMAC, so in the meantime while Tomino was gone and talked with Beryl, we got a call from Beryl, Beryl said I just booked you on the 40 one- nighters, about two or three days, I just booked you on 40 one- nighters already.

And starting such and such a date, so then when I talked to Gail and them, I told them I said, okay, if we don't have your money together, such and such a date, I forget how many days they gave me, I said then we'll have to get together and work on something, because I want to see you get your money, so we'll see what happens.
